description: Verifies, values-only, that a pasted Solana Foundation DvP SwapDvp record is safe to fund: owner must be the pinned DvP program id, account length exactly SwapDvp::LEN 458 bytes, and the stored terms (amount_a/amount_b, expiry, earliest, user_a/user_b, settlement_authority, both settlement destinations) must match the funder-supplied agreed deal, because CreateDvp is permissionless and a forged create with attacker destinations redirects settlement proceeds. Also applies the program windows - earliest_settlement_timestamp <= expiry, expiry <= creation + one year (fixed 365-day year), expiry in the future at a REQUIRED caller-supplied cluster timestamp (never the system clock) - the Token-2022 blocked-extension deny list (TransferFeeConfig, InterestBearingConfig, ScaledUiAmountConfig, NonTransferable, which the program rejects with BlockedMintExtension), and the 32-per-leg transfer-hook extras cap. Trusted-authority risks the program accepts as-is (PermanentDelegate, Pausable, MintCloseAuthority, mutable TransferHook, ConfidentialTransfer, DefaultAccountState/freeze authority) are surfaced as trust flags, never rejections. Values only: no RPC calls, no PDA derivation, no keys, no on-chain writes. The output is a record-vs-terms recompute, NOT legal finality and NOT proof of agreement; the Cantina audit scope mapping for this program commit is UNVERIFIED and never cited as coverage. Every constant is ported from the pinned SOLANA-DVP-* clause snapshots (SOLANA-DVP-RETRIEVAL-1).
